result.rationale:
TopicEmbed.import builds the footer with `contents << "
#{I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")} "` — raw interpolation of `url` into an HTML attribute. The only validation is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:///`, which permits quotes/metacharacters after the scheme. The post is created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` unfiltered for that method, so injected HTML (e.g. a URL like `http://x/'>
